def task_7(task_7_input: List[int], passengers: List[int], capacity: int) -> int:
    task_7_input.sort()
    passengers.sort()
    j = 0
    for t in task_7_input:
        c = capacity
        while c and j < len(passengers) and (passengers[j] <= t):
            (c, j) = (c - 1, j + 1)
    j -= 1
    ans = task_7_input[-1] if c else passengers[j]
    while ~j and passengers[j] == ans:
        (ans, j) = (ans - 1, j - 1)
    return ans
